open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm the exact legal entity (full name, legal form, and state/country of incorporation) that contracts with Tavus for TTS services — Eleven Labs, Inc. (169 Madison Ave #2484, New York, NY 10016)? Please also provide your principal place of business and clarify the role of your Polish entity (ElevenLabs Sp. z o.o. / 'ElevenLabs Poland LLC', ul. Lipska 27/22, 03-907 Warsaw) in the processing chain.

Have you designated a representative under Article 27 GDPR, or do you take the position that Art. 27 does not apply because of your establishment in the EU (Poland)? If a representative exists, please provide name and full address. (Your DSA point-of-contact designation of ElevenLabs Sp. z o.o. is noted, but that is a Digital Services Act designation, not Art. 27 GDPR.)

Have you formally appointed a Data Protection Officer for EU/GDPR purposes? If yes, please provide the DPO's name and telephone number and/or email; if no, please confirm that legal@elevenlabs.io is the authoritative contact entitled to respond to data-protection-related requests (SAP requires a named channel). Please also confirm the correct spelling and current status of the Brazil (LGPD) DPO named in your privacy policy.

Please provide your current SOC 2 Type II report (period covered), ISO 27001 / ISO 27018 / ISO 42001 certificates with scope statements, and PCI DSS attestation under NDA, so Tavus can place them on file (our records show no report on file in Vanta yet).

What minimum TLS version is enforced for data in transit to your core REST and WebSocket API endpoints (the TTS path Tavus uses) — TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3? Your SIP trunking docs state TLS 1.2+, but we need the floor for the main API.
Your enterprise materials state data is encrypted at rest — with which algorithm and key length (e.g. AES-256)?
Are backups encrypted, and with which algorithm?
Who generates and manages the encryption keys for data at rest (platform-managed KMS, customer-specific keys, CMEK/BYOK options)? Which KMS/cloud provider holds them?

Can ElevenLabs, acting as a processor, anonymize and/or pseudonymize customer-submitted personal data (TTS text inputs, voice model inputs, generated speech audio) on the customer's instruction? Your privacy policy documents anonymize-instead-of-delete for your own users — does an equivalent capability exist for API/enterprise customer data?

Is Zero Retention Mode enabled (or available) on the Tavus account, and precisely which data elements are still retained when ZRM is active (e.g. billing metadata, abuse-moderation samples, voice fingerprints)?
For the EU data residency environment: which cloud provider and EU region(s) host it, and does TTS inference for EU-resident workspaces stay entirely in-region including model serving and logging?
Please provide your current sub-processor list for the TTS/API service (SAP requires the processing chain to Level 2, e.g. the underlying cloud provider(s) hosting inference and storage).
